howto: Pick a house on the city map, or press Play for the one marked START HERE.
Choose a tool, then press and drag across the walls and floor to scrub the grime away.
Tap each piece of rubbish to bag it, and buy furniture from the Furnish list.
Press LIST THE HOUSE to sell. Cleaner and better furnished houses earn more stars and profit.
tips: The Goal box shows exactly what two and three stars need, and ticks them off as you go.
Furniture is sold back at 85% of its value, and a few pieces (Armchair, Mirror, Framed Art) are worth more than they cost.
Buy the Scrubber as soon as you can: it cleans much faster than the sponge.
Drag empty space, or right-drag, to turn the room and reach the far walls.
Keep scrubbing without stopping to build a clean streak.

controls.keyboard: Mouse: drag a surface to scrub, drag empty space or right-drag to look, wheel to zoom. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag a surface to scrub, drag empty space to look around, tap rubbish and buttons.

difficulty: Easy, Normal or Hard on the city map. Easy houses start with lighter grime and two fewer pieces of rubbish; Hard ones have heavier grime and three more. Later houses in the list are messier and pay more.

cheats.effect: Every tool cleans a circle three times wider
Every tool in the toolbox is yours, free
All the rubbish in the current house bags itself

settings.quality: City map > Settings > Graphics: Low / High (also in the side panel while cleaning). Low drops shadows and renders at 1x.

features.goals-or-day-targets: Goal box in the side panel: the clean % and furniture value each star needs, ticked live
features.economy-readout: Cash in the HUD; each furniture row shows cost, value and net; each job shows its asking price
features.upgrade-path: Toolbox: buy the Scrubber; sixteen houses, from a small terrace to a penthouse loft, pay more as they get messier
features.end-of-day-summary: The SOLD card after each flip: stars, clean %, furniture value, money spent, profit and the best stars for that house
features.results: SOLD card with Back to the city and Flip it again
features.tutorial: Five coach marks on the first job: tools, scrubbing, the HUD, furnishing and listing; replay from How to play
